code-mode:
Code Mode

IsCode switches the field to a monospace editor styled for source code.

Usage 

@uiForm.TextArea(uiForm.TextAreaSettings{
	InputName: "snippet",
	Label:     "Snippet",

	// OptionalFields
	TwoWayStatePath: "snippet",
	IsCode:          true,
})

floating-button-style:
Floating Button Style

FloatingButtonStyle repaints the expand, copy, and clear actions and changes their size and shape. The text reserves the resolved action width, so a large action never covers the content.

Usage 

@uiForm.TextArea(uiForm.TextAreaSettings{
	InputName: "description",
	Label:     "Description",

	// OptionalFields
	TwoWayStatePath: "description",
	FloatingButtonStyle: uiForm.FloatingButtonStyle{
		BackgroundColor: "secondary-500/20",
		RingColor:       "secondary-500/40",
		Size:            uiControl.ButtonSizeLg,
		Shape:           uiToolset.ShapeCircular,
	},
})

hidden-floating-buttons:
Hidden Floating Buttons

ShouldHideFloatingButtons removes the expand, copy, and clear actions and lets the text use the full width.

Usage 

@uiForm.TextArea(uiForm.TextAreaSettings{
	InputName: "description",
	Label:     "Description",

	// OptionalFields
	TwoWayStatePath:           "description",
	ShouldHideFloatingButtons: true,
})

hints:
Hints

HintValue explains the field. HintDisplay shows it as a description below the field or as a tooltip. The HintDisplayTooltip fields shape the tooltip surface.

Usage 

@uiForm.TextArea(uiForm.TextAreaSettings{
	InputName: "description",
	Label:     "Description",

	// OptionalFields
	TwoWayStatePath:                   "description",
	HintValue:                         "This is a helpful hint.",
	HintDisplay:                       uiForm.InputHintDisplayTooltip,
	HintDisplayTooltipBackgroundColor: "violet-950/95",
	HintDisplayTooltipMinWidthClass:   "min-w-40",
	HintDisplayTooltipMaxWidthClass:   "max-w-64",
	HintDisplayTooltipMinHeightClass:  "min-h-10",
	HintDisplayTooltipMaxHeightClass:  "max-h-24",
})

state-paths:
State Paths

LabelOneWayStatePath reads the label, placeholder, and accessible name from Alpine state. HintStatePath reads the hint text there too, so both update together.

Usage 

@uiForm.TextArea(uiForm.TextAreaSettings{
	InputName: "description",
	Label:     "Description",

	// OptionalFields
	LabelOneWayStatePath: "fieldLabel",
	TwoWayStatePath:      "description",
	HintStatePath:        "hintText",
	HintDisplay:          uiForm.InputHintDisplayTooltip,
})

text-case:
Text Case

TextCase transforms the label and the placeholder. It accepts uiToolset.TextCaseNone (the default, as typed), TextCaseLower, TextCaseUpper, or TextCaseCapitalize.

Usage 

@uiForm.TextArea(uiForm.TextAreaSettings{
	InputName: "description",
	Label:     "Description",

	// OptionalFields
	TwoWayStatePath: "description",
	TextCase:        uiToolset.TextCaseUpper,
})

value-read-only:
Value & Read-Only

Value seeds the field content. IsReadOnly shows the value without accepting edits, and its actions are expand and copy only: a read-only field never offers the clear action.

Usage 

@uiForm.TextArea(uiForm.TextAreaSettings{
	InputName:       "description",
	Label:           "Description",
	TwoWayStatePath: "description",

	// OptionalFields
	IsReadOnly: true,
})
